description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint for retrieving the current date and time within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It includes a class `CurrentDateTimeAPI` that extends a generic `Endpoint` and implements resource endpoint behavior to return a datetime model object. The file contains annotation comments for API documentation, uses traits and services to obtain the current UTC datetime, and adheres to the structure of a resource API endpoint with unimplemented update, delete, and validation methods.
